preconditions.description: The number of main courses k and total courses n are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in main_courses) and len(set(main_courses)) == k
preconditions.description: The k main courses are distinct integers between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= t_i <= n - 1 for t_i in t_list) and sum(t_list) <= 10**5
preconditions.description: Each course's dependency count t_i is valid, and the total dependencies do not exceed 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= dep <= n and dep != i for dep in dependencies[i])
preconditions.description: Each dependency of course i is a distinct course other than itself.

postconditions.description: Output is either '-1' or a valid sequence of m (number of courses) followed by m distinct course numbers.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (all(1 <= x <= n for x in course_sequence) and len(set(course_sequence)) == len(course_sequence))
postconditions.description: If output is not '-1', the course sequence contains distinct integers between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: stdout != '-1' and all(course in main_courses or any(course in dependencies[main] for main in main_courses) for course in course_sequence)
postconditions.description: The output sequence includes all main courses and their required dependencies.

postconditions.expression: stdout != '-1' and all(course_sequence[i] not in dependencies[course_sequence[j]] for i in range(len(course_sequence)) for j in range(i))
postconditions.description: The output sequence respects the dependency order: no course appears before its dependencies.
The output sequence has the minimum possible number of courses to include all main courses and their dependencies.
